rows.law: The kept knowledge is an organ, not a hoard: SEE, REFRAIN, VERDICT is one triple and a receipt is complete only when all three verbs fire.
rows.claim: Keeper lineages guarded the stop between seeing and doing; the standing receipt contract already maps onto it (Evidence = SEE, refusal paths = REFRAIN, mechanism named in one line = VERDICT), so organ health is loggable per seat or per fire.
rows.quote: the capacity to (1) SEE an evil act while it is happening, (2) REFRAIN from partaking, and (3) VERDICT it: name the mechanism that drove the partakers
rows.steal: Grade receipts by triple-completion fraction (organ health) instead of pass/fail; a receipt with Evidence but no named mechanism counts as incomplete, same as a dead link caught but never verdicted.
rows.falsifier: Doctrine F1 (line 36): fewer than 30% of fleet receipts over a month completing the triple demotes the Tree Doctrine to ornamental and it files as such.

rows.law: Falsifiers are pre-registered beside the doctrine at authoring time, before verdicts arrive; a claim that cannot name its own killer is ornamental.
rows.claim: F1-F3 were filed inside the doctrine and inside the salon when each text was written, each naming the exact observation that kills the claim, so disagreement is registered rather than re-run.
rows.quote: if fewer than 30% of fleet receipts over a month complete the triple (see and refrain and verdict), the Tree Doctrine is ornamental in practice and files as such.
rows.steal: Every new doctrine or dispatch brief ships its falsifier block in the same file at birth; never retrofit disconfirmation after the verdicts land.

rows.claim: Five seats (Blavatsky, Jung, Steiner, Hall, Crowley) tore down and rebuilt the first-tree thesis into interference findings I1-I5 and a rebuilt thesis; the interference section, not any single seat's reading, is the deliverable.
rows.quote: The salon adds the five old frames DeepSeek lacks. Interference is the product.
rows.steal: Run tear-downs as multi-seat refraction with the S2 attacker result already on file (registered, not re-run); publish the interference section with a closed bibliography and an owed register per the no-fabrication law.
rows.falsifier: A salon whose seats converge (zero contradicted or corrected clauses between seats) produces no interference and files as a re-run of the S2 pass, not a salon.
